description: Find USDA AMS livestock price reports (Livestock Mandatory Price Reporting): national and regional direct slaughter cattle, boxed beef and cow-beef cutouts, hogs and pork, lamb. Filter by words in the title and/or species (cattle, beef, swine, pork, lamb). Returns report_id, report code, title, the sections each report has, and when AMS last published it. Use the report_id with ams_report. Livestock only (produce, grain, hay and cotton: ams_market_report_search); if nothing matches it says so and states what is not covered (it never returns a bare empty list).

query.description: Words that must all appear in the report title, e.g. "boxed beef cutout" or "weekly direct slaughter".

name: ams_report_search
